decisive_items: atrophic lesions on his face, symmetric and bilateral, located especially on the malar and preauricular areas
superficial dermal lymphocytic infiltrate associated with dermal fibrosis
response.rationale: The combination of atrophic lesions, superficial dermal lymphocytic infiltrate, and dermal fibrosis is more consistent with discoid lupus erythematosus than with other options.

rejected.why: Lack of specific histopathologic features of follicular mucinosis
Follicular lupus is less likely due to the absence of specific follicular involvement
Atrophic dermatofibrosis is less likely due to the presence of lymphocytic infiltrate
Follicular atrophoderma is less likely due to the absence of specific follicular atrophy
